what: pqc — the drawing half of /instruments/pqc, ported verbatim from frontier-apps tools/pqc-app.js. Two views on one instrument: the LLL reduction animated (141 snapshots, profile as a ratio of exact Gram determinants) and the wall (926 records against 1.05). Canvas 2D; every dash is a heuristic that was asserted, every solid mark was decided.
rule: Byte-for-byte; the builder beside it is the house port of tools/build-pqc.js. The records it draws are instruments/pqc/out/*.json, pinned and re-derived there.
